fact_previews: A production-ready AI-driven Fraud Detection platform has been built for payment providers.
A working prototype of a Real-Time AI-driven Fraud Detection platform has been developed for online merchants.
The HawkEye Platform is a payment fraud detection engine that delivers risk mitigating decisions in real-time.
The HawkEye Platform incorporates multiple AI tools and decision layers to analyze transaction flows holistically.
The first layer of the HawkEye Platform is the HawkEye Rule Engine, which captures a high amount of fraud by screening transactional data against a set of rules.

fact_previews: The supervised learning model classifies transactions as either fraud or non-fraud.
The model is applied on top of the existing rules engine to identify fraudulent transactions that may not have been alerted by the rules.
The HawkEye Autoencoder is trained to create feature representations of valid transactions to detect deviations from the norm.
Deviations above a pre-set threshold are considered candidates for fraud.
Clients can connect to the HawkEye Platform using REST API for easy integration into their information systems.
